name: AnyPS5
summary: Ports PS5 game and app executables to Linux and Windows. Strictly it is a relinker, not an emulator: it links the game against its own PS5 system library implementations and recompiles shaders to Vulkan, so the game runs as a native program with no emulator process.
how: Dump a game you own from a jailbroken PS5: one executable ELF plus its sce_sys/ and sce_module/ folders.
Convert it with the desktop release or the web converter; the web converter runs in your browser and keeps files on your device.
Run the converted program on Linux or Windows; controllers work through SDL, mapped in anyps5-input.ini.
requirements: Your own legally obtained app dump (ELF, sce_sys/, sce_module/)
A Linux or Windows PC with a Vulkan GPU
warnings: Early 0.1.x release: many games are blocked; check the community blocker map before converting.
AnyPS5 bundles no firmware or keys; dumping your own games needs a jailbroken console.
